ui.bekhilitt.escape: Esc: stop and retain the checkpoint
story.bekhilitt.injury.objective: Short staged scene · controls temporarily locked
story.bekhilitt.transport.body: The Hawks carry the unconscious Guts back to camp.
story.bekhilitt.recovery.body: On Griffith’s orders, Casca keeps the wounded Guts warm. He slowly regains consciousness.
story.bekhilitt.awakening.body: Guts wakes in the Hawks’ camp. You have control again.
story.bekhilitt.awakening.objective: Look around. Casca is beside the tent.
story.bekhilitt.casca.page1: Casca explains that Guts was brought here after being wounded. This is the Hawks’ camp.
story.bekhilitt.casca.page2: She kept him warm on Griffith’s orders. As Guts recovers, he learns who ordered that he be cared for.
story.bekhilitt.casca.page3: Guts is to speak with Griffith. His conversation with Casca is over.
story.bekhilitt.casca.objective: Approach Casca by the tent to speak with her.
story.bekhilitt.griffith.page1: Griffith takes an interest in Guts’ strength. A challenge to a duel follows.
story.bekhilitt.griffith.page2: This duel will decide Guts’ place among the Hawks. You can strike, defend and dodge during the fight.
story.bekhilitt.griffith.objective: Speak to Griffith beside the dueling ground.
story.bekhilitt.duel.body: Griffith approaches. Keep your distance and watch his blade.
story.bekhilitt.duel.objective: Land two hits, block, and evade an attack. Up to 90 seconds; the outcome is part of the story.
story.bekhilitt.end.body: Guts loses to Griffith and joins the Band of the Hawk. The first episode is complete.
story.bekhilitt.end.objective: Episode complete. Continue to stay in camp; /bekhilitt stop to leave.
story.bekhilitt.duel.warning.body: Griffith prepares to end the duel. The staged ending begins in three seconds.
story.bekhilitt.duel.finish.body: Griffith takes control and ends the duel. This is temporary game staging.
story.bekhilitt.duel.result.body: Guts loses to Griffith. Joining the Band of the Hawk and the episode’s end follow.
story.bekhilitt.duel.result.objective: Duel over · joining the Hawks next
hud.bekhilitt.training.hit: Move close and tap attack twice. Holding the button uses a different skill.
hud.bekhilitt.training.guard: Face Griffith and hold guard before his attack.
hud.bekhilitt.training.dodge: Evade an incoming attack. A roll without a threat does not count.
story.bekhilitt.practice.body: Separate practice after the completed episode: Epic Fight’s native Demolition Leap and Meteor Slam. No damage or destruction; the story is already complete.
story.bekhilitt.practice.objective: No damage or destruction · story complete
hud.bekhilitt.practice.leap: Demolition Leap: hold %s for 0.6–2 s, then release.
hud.bekhilitt.practice.slam: Meteor Slam: airborne, look down ≥40° at a block over 6 m away, then tap %s.
hud.bekhilitt.practice.exit: Up to 5 minutes. /bekhilitt stop ends practice and returns you.
story.bekhilitt.camp.objective: Safe camp · Combat disabled · Right-click to talk · /bekhilitt practice · /bekhilitt stop to leave
story.bekhilitt.camp.casca: The first episode is complete. Explore the camp and approach Casca or Griffith again. This conversation changes no story events and grants no rewards. Use /bekhilitt stop to leave and restore your original state. Return with /bekhilitt camp.
story.bekhilitt.camp.griffith: The duel and joining the Hawks are already saved. The mandatory fight cannot be replayed. Optional movement practice is available with /bekhilitt practice. It safely ends this camp visit first. After practice, return with /bekhilitt camp. No new story mission begins here.
